requirement: The hub's Google verifier checks a contribution's category against the primary type and its opening hours against the normalized weekly periods; email, social profiles and photo references stay unsupported

oracle.ref: PR #1696 (feat); fix evidence: Before: category and opening_hours had no Google check, so every such observation was rejected as unsupported_source
oracle.invariant: S1: one Google read; 'Cafe' accepted, 'bar' differs_from_source; reordered periods accepted, subset and changed time differs_from_source; matching text accepted, other text differs_from_source. S2: both rejected as unsupported_source with no Google read. S3: the mask asks for primaryType and regularOpeningHours; the answer carries category and openingHours with only day/hour/minute per period.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
